edits.text: PARTIES. This Agreement is between Vireo Systems Inc. (the “Company”) and [Executive legal name] (the “Executive”). The effective date shall be [date].

1. POSITION. The Executive shall serve as Chief Operating Officer, reporting to the Chief Executive Officer, and shall perform duties customary to that position. The Executive’s principal work location shall be [location, subject to agreement].

2. COMPENSATION. The Executive shall receive an annual base salary of $325,000 (the “Base Salary”), payable in accordance with the Company’s regular payroll practices and subject to required withholding. The Executive shall be eligible to participate in health and retirement benefit plans made available to similarly situated senior executives, subject to applicable plan terms. The Company may amend those plans on a basis generally applicable to similarly situated senior executives.

3. SEVERANCE. Upon termination by the Company without Cause or resignation by the Executive for Good Reason, the Company shall pay 12 months of the Executive’s then-current Base Salary in substantially equal installments under its regular payroll practices. If the Executive timely elects continuation coverage under COBRA or applicable state law, the Company shall pay the employer portion of the premium at the same rate applicable immediately before termination for up to 12 months, ending earlier upon expiration of continuation eligibility or eligibility for comparable coverage from a new employer. These severance benefits are conditioned on the Executive executing and not revoking a reasonable release of employment-related claims within 60 days after termination. Salary continuation shall commence on the first regular payroll date after that period, with a catch-up payment for installments otherwise due; if the period spans two calendar years, payment shall commence in the second year. Accrued salary, reimbursable expenses, vested benefits, and other amounts required by law shall be paid independently of any release. “Cause” means fraud or embezzlement involving the Company; conviction of, or a guilty or no-contest plea to, a felony involving dishonesty or materially impairing the Executive’s ability to perform duties; willful misconduct causing material harm to the Company; or a material breach of this Agreement or willful refusal to perform lawful duties consistent with the Executive’s position. For any curable ground, Cause requires written notice specifying the conduct and at least 30 days to cure. “Good Reason” means, without the Executive’s written consent, a material reduction in Base Salary, a material diminution in authority, duties or responsibilities, relocation of the principal work location by more than 50 miles, or a material breach of this Agreement by the Company. Good Reason requires written notice within 60 days after the Executive learns of the condition, 30 days for the Company to cure, and resignation within 30 days after the cure period expires if the condition remains uncured.

4. CONFIDENTIALITY; LIMITED NON-SOLICITATION. No post-employment non-compete shall apply. The Executive shall not use or disclose Company confidential information except in performing duties for the Company or as permitted or required by law. Confidential information excludes information lawfully available to the public other than through a breach of duty. Nothing in this Agreement restricts lawful reporting to government agencies, protected whistleblowing, or other legally protected activity. For 12 months after termination, to the extent permitted by applicable law, the Executive shall not directly solicit for employment an employee of the Company with whom the Executive worked materially during the preceding 12 months. General advertisements not targeted at Company employees and hiring resulting from unsolicited approaches are excluded.

The non-solicitation provision remains subject to review once the principal work location and governing law are confirmed. The complete draft should include applicable statutory whistleblower and trade-secret immunity notices and any necessary tax-compliance provisions.

Any release must exclude accrued and vested entitlements, indemnification rights and rights under this Agreement; the employee non-solicit remains subject to agreement on work location and governing law, and the final draft must include applicable whistleblower, trade-secret immunity and tax-compliance provisions.
